datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Mali on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2015. Geographic polygons represent areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating severity of acute food insecurity, with scenario variations captured for different analytical assumptions.
